[PREFERENCE] User is wondering if there’s a way to track their route and pace while running.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended running apps: Strava, Runkeeper, Nike Run Club, MapMyRun, Garmin Connect, Runtastic, Google Fit.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Strava offers GPS tracking, pace analysis, and route mapping with a social component.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Runkeeper provides detailed route tracking, pace monitoring, and audio cues.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Nike Run Club offers GPS tracking, personalized coaching, and customizable workouts.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] MapMyRun offers GPS tracking, route mapping, and pace analysis with integration to wearable devices.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Garmin Connect is excellent for Garmin wearable device users with advanced tracking features.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Runtastic offers GPS tracking, pace analysis, and customizable workouts with a built-in music player.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Google Fit offers GPS tracking, pace monitoring, and integration with other Google services.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested steps before running: download and install the app, create an account, familiarize with features, bring phone and gear, stay hydrated.

[PREFERENCE] User finds the Adidas Ultraboost 22 super comfortable.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided a step-by-step guide on how to clean and maintain the Adidas Ultraboost 22.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cleaning steps include removing insoles and laces, brushing off dirt, mixing a cleaning solution, dampening a cloth, focusing on high-wear areas, rinsing with clean water, and air drying.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested avoiding harsh chemicals and using gentle stain removers for tough stains.
